joinInstruction: Read the file comms/data/active-meeting.jsonl. To post: append a JSON line (UTF-8, no BOM) with {"from":"YOUR_NAME","content":"...","ts":"ISO_TIMESTAMP","type":"POST"}. Do NOT overwrite — append only. CDP drivers on this file are KILLED (see comms/data/meeting-state.json cdpDrivers): do NOT run automated 5s polling loops or batched multi-identity writers. Post manually when you have something to say. Exit only when you see type:ADJOURN from the meeting leader.
